name: taskbullet
description: Place a real US or Canada phone call, or hand work the agent cannot finish to a TaskBullet virtual assistant.

TASKBULLET_API_KEY.title: TaskBullet API key
TASKBULLET_API_KEY.description: tb_live_ key from https://taskbullet.com/dashboard/settings/api-keys. Shown once. Enter it here. Do not paste it into chat.

TASKBULLET_HTTP_TOKEN.title: Local HTTP token
TASKBULLET_HTTP_TOKEN.description: Only for a non-loopback HTTP bind. Leave blank for the default stdio server. Not the TaskBullet API key.
